input_meta.composition: Independent seeded PCG64 permutations of authenticated record IDs; no repeated record within job; cross-job reuse charged and disclosed
input_meta.executable_input: Exact captured BF16 hidden states only; actual stock gate/topk in measured forward

source_weights.replay_scope: Controlled synthetic activations and logical routes; actual pretrained expert weights

per_rank_state.peak_memory_scope: Whole process, all comparators and prepared inputs/references; not standalone engine
Whole process, all comparators and prepared inputs/references; not standalone engine

selected_fix.decision: Evaluate one bounded exact-kernel invocation repair. Reused development remained slower than EPLB-off in all four groups; this is not a demonstrated speedup or deployment recommendation.
changes: Warm and bind both exact unchanged int32/int64 Triton compiled kernels once.
Preserve actual native gate/topk and combining weights, input checks, fixed map, native expert alignment/allocation/GEMM geometry and output reduction.
Use bound compiled launchers with explicit constructing stream; check pointer alignment and reject unsupported JIT hooks/global dependencies.

diagnostic_basis.scope: Four reused pilot groups; exact physical-ID replay only a diagnostic; input checks had no consistent benefit.

development_basis.scope: Four reused pilot groups, two reverse technical repetitions. Descriptive only; no confidence intervals.

limits: Exact pinned Triton3.7.1 and SM90 compiled signatures; fixed B128/top8/map only.
Sequential constructing stream; no concurrent reuse, graphs or deployment integration.
Native full expert-kernel launch extent retained; rejected trim result preserved.
Keep prior5%response useful-gain criterion and2%regression margins unchanged.

output_reduction_probe.scope: One untimed actual stock forward; delegate-only backend observation restored before timing

output_reduction_probe_per_rank.scope: One untimed actual stock forward; delegate-only backend observation restored before timing
One untimed actual stock forward; delegate-only backend observation restored before timing

completion_contract: Jobresponse ends after output GPU completion and common ACK; native async normal commit tail charged into quiescent/completed elapsed separately

queue_metrics.latency_definition: coordinator completion minus immutable scheduled arrival; includes queue/admission delay and CPU command/ACK coordination
queue_metrics.arrival_unit: synthetic preassembled B-token layer job; not a user/chat request
queue_metrics.percentile_scope: descriptive within-run percentiles; jobs/cycles are not independent source-block replicates

calibration_capacity.definition: jobs/(last coordinator finish-first coordinator command start); includes inter-job gaps
